blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte has a “loose” investment with an unspecified amount which yielded a return of more than P2 million from 2022 to 2025 alone. This is what a defense witness told the Senate impeachment court on Wednesday. According to GenCorp counsel Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay, this amount has a “very big difference” compared to the hundreds of millions previously computed by prosecution’s expert witness Alexander Cabrera, a forensic financial analyst. ‘Very big difference’ Punay said GenCorp disbursed a total of more than P2.1 million in 2022 to 2025 as “return of capital” through bank checks.
